items.description: Metaheuristic optimizer that uses a KVM executor to run and score x86 machine code — applying simulated annealing, tabu search, and hybrid solvers to evolve programs directly at the instruction level.

Bamboo OS Wonder is a complete x86-64 operating system built entirely from scratch. Bamboo OS is generated by Python code that produces native x86-64 machine code at build time. The project has evolved through 10 major versions, from a basic kernel prototype to a fully-featured desktop operating system that anyone can use.
